messages:
support-ian: Escalation from Acme (tenant acme-prod). Intermittent 502s + tail latency spikes on POST /v1/embeddings around 14:23 UTC. Seen across multiple request IDs: r:acme:0a1b2c and r:acme:0a1b2d. They report it happens for batches ~10-20 items. Cluster: eu-dedicated-03. Can we capture pod logs, node procstat, and a GPU snapshot + dmesg? Need a reproducible curl if possible.
maria-eng-oncall: On it. I'll collect pod logs for acme-prod pods and grab nvidia-smi + pmon. Which pod names? I can grep by tenant label.
devon-support: Tenant provided a quick reproducer but we sanitized tokens. Here's a minimal reproducer they used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"embed-3b","input":["short sentence 1","short sentence 2"]}' 
  https://eu.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings
```
It fails intermittently with 502 and timeout at ~10s.
ajay-infra: Node list for eu-dedicated-03: node-eu-03a, node-eu-03b, node-eu-03c. Tenant pods are scheduled on node-eu-03b right now (acme-prod-embed-7f8c9). I'll capture GPU metrics and dmesg. Commands I plan to run:
```bash
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l tenant=acme-prod -o wide
kubectl -n dedicated logs acme-prod-embed-7f8c9 --since=30m > /tmp/acme-prod-embed-7f8c9.logs
ssh node-eu-03b "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/nvidia-smi.csv & sleep 30; pkill -f nvidia-smi"
ssh node-eu-03b "sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /tmp/acme-dmesg.txt"
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 500 > /tmp/kubelet-journal.txt
ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -n 20 > /tmp/top-proc.txt
```
I'll upload to the support bucket once done.
maria-eng-oncall: Adding a quick capture for in-process traces and KV cache size from the runtime. On the pod:
```bash
kubectl -n dedicated exec acme-prod-embed-7f8c9 -- sh -c "cat /proc/$(pidof redwood-runtime)/status" > /tmp/proc_runtime_status.txt
kubectl -n dedicated exec acme-prod-embed-7f8c9 -- sh -c "curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9000/metrics | grep kv_cache" > /tmp/kv_cache_metrics.txt
```
Also grabbing the request log lines for the two request IDs:
```bash
kubectl -n dedicated logs acme-ingress --since=1h | egrep "0a1b2c|0a1b2d" > /tmp/ingress-reqs.txt
```
sre-bot: support-bundle-started id=sb-20260317-001 by maria-eng-oncall. Upload target: s3://redwood-support/acme-prod/sb-20260317-001/
ajay-infra: Collected nvidia-smi snapshot (sample output attached):
```
index, utilization.gpu [%], utilization.memory [%], memory.used [MiB]
0, 99 %, 45 %, 12288 MiB
1, 12 %, 8 %, 537 MiB
```
Noted GPU0 saturating during one capture period.
maria-eng-oncall: Pod logs show repeated gRPC timeouts and a few "NVML: Uncorrectable ECC error" messages interleaved with runtime restarts. Excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T14:22:34Z runtime[pid=1234]: grpc: recv timeout after 10000ms request_id=r:acme:0a1b2c
2026-03-17T14:22:36Z runtime[pid=1234]: nvml: driver reset detected
2026-03-17T14:22:36Z runtime[pid=1234]: saving checkpoint
2026-03-17T14:22:37Z runtime[pid=1234]: started new worker pid=1251
```
devon-support: Good find. Please include the full kernel logs (dmesg) and any oopses. Also include the pod env dump and the k8s pod YAML for the scheduled pod.
maria-eng-oncall: Done. Collected and uploaded to s3://redwood-support/acme-prod/sb-20260317-001/ with these files:
- acme-prod-embed-7f8c9.logs
- nvidia-smi.csv
- acme-dmesg.txt
- kubelet-journal.txt
- proc_runtime_status.txt
- kv_cache_metrics.txt
- ingress-reqs.txt
- pod-env-acme-prod-7f8c9.yaml
jules-cx: Thanks team. I've pinged the customer with the bundle link and asked them to reproduce with the same payload and capture the exact request timestamp if it happens again. Also CC'd them on the S3 link.
ajay-infra: Quick note — node-eu-03b shows a driver log line around the event: "NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 45" which tends to indicate a GPU hang/reset. I recommend we schedule a node drain and repro with updated driver on a single node to validate.
devon-support: We'll mark this P1 until we confirm root cause. Action items:
- infra to repro on staged node (ajay-infra)
- eng to review runtime NVML interaction and fallback (maria-eng-oncall)
- support to coordinate with customer and confirm timestamps (devon-support/jules-cx)
sre-bot: support-bundle-complete id=sb-20260317-001 size=24MB path=s3://redwood-support/acme-prod/sb-20260317-001/
maria-eng-oncall: Leaving notes in the ticket: probable GPU driver reset leading to transient 502s. Next step: repro on a single node with stress workload and upgraded driver. I'll open a dedicated repro run in the lab and link results here.
jules-cx: Adding a slack follow-up with the customer for a scheduled repro window tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Will update ticket when confirmed. :thumbsup:
